# CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database — términos de uso

Fuente original: <http://mocap.cs.cmu.edu> (Carnegie Mellon University). Conversión a BVH
"Daz-friendly, hip-corrected" de Bruce Hahne (cgspeed.com, 2010), tomada del repositorio
<https://github.com/adventuring/mocap> (`CMU/`, archivo `LICENSE-CMU-Mocap.txt`).

Texto de uso de CMU (citado en el `LICENSE-CMU-Mocap.txt` de la conversión):

> Use this data! This data is free for use in research and commercial projects worldwide. If you
> publish results obtained using this data, we would appreciate it if you would send the citation to
> your published paper to jkh+mocap@cs.cmu.edu, and also would add this text to your
> acknowledgments section: "The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The
> database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217."

Y de la conversión a BVH:

> CMU places no restrictions on the use of the original dataset, and I (Bruce) place no additional
> restrictions on the use of this particular BVH conversion.

**Créditos que debe llevar el juego:** "The data used in this project was obtained from
mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217."
